acceptance.evidence: READ_ONLY_CHECK_RECEIPT.json records the reviewed candidate digest, 2026-11-12T18:14:05Z WAIT on PID 490003, identical seven before/after control digests and no execute/model/GPU test. The source path returns before run.lock/COMPLETION/GPU checks while the exact original PID remains alive. This reviewer did not repeat that run.

declared_operational_assumptions.choice: A cooperating operator will not concurrently allocate GPU0 through another mechanism between the gate and child start
declared_operational_assumptions.assessment: Declared and consistent with reuse of the existing worker's start-time recheck; no new allocation mechanism is needed for this scope.

declared_operational_assumptions.choice: Any consumed one-shot claim requires separate explicit manual recovery, even if failure occurred before spawn
declared_operational_assumptions.declared_at: SPEC.md final paragraph; EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.md crash/manual-recovery paragraph
declared_operational_assumptions.assessment: Implemented by persistent exclusive claim and no automatic retry. Conservative blocking after interruption is intentional.

declared_operational_assumptions.choice: WORKER_EXITED_OK is the child exit result; a later operator HOLD may end the worker before all ten runs
declared_operational_assumptions.assessment: Consistent with original native hold semantics; lane/event state remains the completion authority.
